t: This is the site of the Stoll Theatre in Westminster, a former opera house that later became a cinema. It was designed by Bertie Crewe, who was one of the leading English theatre architects in the boom years between 1885 and 1915. In that period, new theatres went up all over the country, and Crewe was among the people designing them. So the place you are standing in is part of a wider story of Edwardian and late Victorian theatre building.
